test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Amit starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards the south. He then takes a left turn, drives 4 km, turns right and drives 3 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 7 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 9 km and stops at Point B. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A from Point B? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
As per the given information,

1) Amit starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards the south.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7707bd5f7d24415bb58c16e3db2751ff1ab46e3982e2f28851272a94ba79937f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9af7f2adb5dce47963b92b188fac78eb8bebe2fbf0ce273aaceb310f0003bd9.png] 

 

2) He then takes a left turn, drives 4 km, turns right and drives 3 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e6fd2ca1436605dc767d5008c605035ab059c8d23de4432dc4c15903ff265f0.png] 

3) He then takes a right turn and drives 7 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b9aa456da50ebe32491935dec0758687c27596914850e353a384632c99ae939.png] 

4) He takes a final right turn, drives 9 km and stops at point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f0beaa24a01309e0b872c6eed908fe7bef9030fa44f2557f8de9adf71909f21.png] 

Here, we can see that he needs to drive 3 km towards the East to reach point A from point B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"3 km towards the East"**.
